sources.title: I Just Tried The Brand New Ternary Model And It's Great!
sources.snippet: We can now get FP16 model accuracy but at 1Bit size. The entire idea of Ternary is the best of both worlds. For just a bit more memory, but still 7-8x less than FP16, you can get *FULL* FP16 accuracy.

sources.title: [2406.07177] TernaryLLM: Ternarized Large Language Model
sources.snippet: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable performance on Natural Language Processing (NLP) tasks, but they are hindered by high computational costs and memory requirements. Ternarization, an extreme form of quantization, offers a solution by reducing memory usage and enabling energy-efficient floating-point additions.
